sloka: ऊचुः संश्रवणे ये मां द्विजाः कार्तान्तिकाः शुभाम् ।ते ऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनो ऽनृतवादिनः ।। ६.४८.४ ।।।।
transliteration: ūcuḥ saṁśravaṇe ye māṁ dvijāḥ kārtāntikāḥ śubhām ।te 'dya sarve hate rāme jñānino 'nṛtavādinaḥ ।। 6.48.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "The astrologers, brahmins who have promised me to be auspicious and all the wise who have spoken are liars if Rama is killed."
